# With "output_exported_default_identifiers": false the routes function of each
# package is unexported, and the hub is still exported, so the packages build
# and each package's own test serves a page that links to the other.

muxt generate
muxt check
exec go build ./...
exec go test ./admin ./blog

-- go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.22
-- muxt.json --
{
  "route_paths": {},
  "package_defaults": {
    "use_receiver_type": "Server",
    "output_exported_default_identifiers": false
  },
  "packages": {
    "example.com/m/admin": [
      {}
    ],
    "example.com/m/blog": [
      {}
    ]
  }
}
-- admin/admin.go --
package admin

import "html/template"

var templates = template.Must(template.New("GET /admin Dashboard()").Parse(`<a href="{{$.Path.Blog.GetArticle 42}}">article</a>`))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Dashboard() string { return "dashboard" }
-- admin/admin_test.go --
package admin

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestLinksToBlog(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	templateRoutes(mux, Server{})
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/admin", nil))
	if body, want := rec.Body.String(), `href="/article/42"`; !strings.Contains(body, want) {
		t.Errorf("GET /admin body = %q, want it to contain %q", body, want)
	}
}
-- blog/blog.go --
package blog

import "html/template"

var templates = template.Must(template.New("GET /article/{id} GetArticle(id)").Parse(`<h1>{{.Result}}</h1><a href="{{.Path.Admin.Dashboard}}">admin</a>`))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) GetArticle(id int) string { return "article" }
-- blog/blog_test.go --
package blog

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestLinksToAdmin(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	templateRoutes(mux, Server{})
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/article/7", nil))
	if body, want := rec.Body.String(), `href="/admin"`; !strings.Contains(body, want) {
		t.Errorf("GET /article/7 body = %q, want it to contain %q", body, want)
	}
}
